channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nico Harrison | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nico Harrison from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Nico Harrison
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“So many people crushed Nico for the reasons that he gave. When Nico gave those reasons everybody said he’s ridiculous, he’s crazy. Now when I turn on the tv all I see is media who crushed Nico which essentially aided in him getting fired, regurgitating the same things that Nico Harrison was saying. I haven’t seen one person come out and say ‘hey Nico, I’m sorry for the things I said about you when you made those moves because I just said the same things out of my mouth.’ This has nothing to do with Luka and everything to do with the media and Nico Harrison. Nico gave his reasoning as why he thought that was the right move. Everybody said ‘you’re a f*cking idiot”

Draymond Green on Nico Harrison, Feb 27, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Nico Harrison, Patrick Dumont
item.description:
“Nico’s my guy. Obviously, he played a huge part of getting me here and wanting me to fulfill his vision, in a sense, that he saw. It was definitely tough. ...It’s the business of basketball. Once I had those conversations [with Harrison and Dumont], I was able to move forward and continue to rehab and get back on the floor and try to compete.”

Anthony Davis on Nico Harrison, Patrick Dumont, Nov 26, 2025. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Anthony Davis, Luka Doncic, Nico Harrison
item.description:
“Then he had the bad luck of Anthony Davis never being available basically. “Butthe thing that bothers me is he’s just being made a scapegoat. Listen, Shaq knows this, Kenny knows this, there’s no way in the world Nico Harrison had the power to trade Luka Doncic unless the owner of the team signed off on it. That was his call, so I feel bad the way Nico’s being made a scapegoat.”

Charles Barkley on Anthony Davis, Luka Doncic, Nico Harrison, Nov 14, 2025. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Nico Harrison
item.description:
Mark Cuban on the moment he heard about the AD-Luka trade from Nico Harrison:

“I was in an event in Florida, and it was Saturday night, I think, and maybe 11. I get a text from Nico. Um, or maybe he called me, and I called him back, and I thought he was asking me, you know, what do you think about this? And thenI realized he was telling me that this was done. And obviously I was not happy at all. And then I called the owner, Patrick, and I'm like,”

Mark Cuban on Nico Harrison, Sep 12, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Nico Harrison
item.description:
However, former NBA All-Star Gilbert Arenas believes Harrison shouldn't bear all the blame.

“The fact Nico [Harrison] still has his job lets you know it had nothing to do with Nico. He’s just the one that gets punished for it. You can’t really throw dirt on his name, obviously, he’s just the middleman here,”

Gilbert Arenas on Nico Harrison, Apr 13, 2025. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Kyrie Irving, Nico Harrison
item.description:
Mark Cuban on trusting Nico Harrison's recommendation of Kyrie Irving:

“Nico’s like, 'He’s a good dude, man,' and I would talk to people around him, andevery single human being that I talked to that played with him was in the same organization as him, all said, 'He’s a great dude, just misunderstood, and if you just respect who he is, he’ll respect you back.' And I was like, that’s easy to do.”

Mark Cuban on Kyrie Irving, Nico Harrison, Aug 30, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Patrick Dumont on Nico Harrison
item.description:
“The league wants one person to speak to, so that’s me. But I intend to get the benefit of Mark’s experience and his success. So working with him is actually a benefit to our organization. That’s how I see it. “Nico Harrison is the GM. He is the head of basketball operations. So we all get the benefit of working with Mark, but there’s one GM. That’s Nico. … So in some ways we get the best of both worlds.“You have the benefit of an owner that’s won a championship,”

Patrick Dumont on Nico Harrison, May 27, 2024. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Patrick Dumont on Nico Harrison
item.description:
Publicly, until now, Dumont’s only comments about the Mavericks were in press releases, but privately he’s been making personal connections throughout the franchise.

“I have to tell you, I think Nico Harrison is incredibly talented,”

Patrick Dumont on Nico Harrison, Feb 11, 2024. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Patrick Dumont on Nico Harrison
item.description:

Patrick Dumont on Nico Harrison, Feb 11, 2024. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Jason Kidd, Nico Harrison
item.description:
.@Mark Cuban on the hiring of Jason Kidd and Nico Harrison:

“I’m excited!!! Both are incredible and have the experience , knowledge, passion and love for the game to lead us into a very bright future.”

Mark Cuban on Jason Kidd, Nico Harrison, Jun 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @townbrad.
